HRH the Crown Prince and Prime Minister congratulates the Sultan of Brunei Darussalam

His Royal Highness Prince Salman bin Hamad Al Khalifa, the Crown Prince and Prime Minister, today sent a cable of congratulations to His Majesty Sultan Haji Hassanal Bolkiah of Brunei Darussalam, on the occasion of the Kingdom of Brunei’s National Day.

His Royal Highness sent a similar cable to the Crown Prince of Brunei, HH the Crown Prince Haji Al-Muhtadee Billah. | Hassanal Bolkiah Charity Foundation | Facebook
